summary: Input /workspace/data/records.csv is incomplete: README specifies 24 records (R001-R024) but the file contains only 18. Missing IDs are R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021 - every 4th record starting at R001, suggesting systematic loss during generation/transfer rather than random gaps. Only three regions (North, South, West) appear in the surviving rows; it cannot be determined whether the 6 missing records belong to these or to an unrepresented fourth region, so regional totals cannot be certified complete. /shared/notes is empty, so no earlier job in the batch documented this. Deliverables were produced with status="blocked", record_count=18, and partial totals clearly labelled as covering only the 18 present records. Needs a human to supply the complete CSV or confirm the 18-row file is authoritative.
